title: Draft POs for 6 stocked-out core M/L SKUs (polo + chino)

payload.method: order-up-to = reorder point (velocity × lead time + 1.65σ√LT) + 10 weeks; MOQ checked per style-colour
payload.open_question_for_operator: Sea ETA misses projected stockout by 42-51 days and overlaps BFCM. Air-freight a partial (cost not in mirror)?

impact.method: scenario step 45 (trailing-12m lost units × incremental unit CM)

risks: A 42-51 day gap is unavoidable by sea; this PO prevents the next stockout, not the current one.
Impact assumes last year's stockout pattern would repeat; it's a policy fix, not a one-off.
Kaveri on-time rate is 86%; a late PO extends the gap.
